name: Brick
author: whirligig
notes: Phase 0 test article: a 1.2 kg box on four stiff feet. It has no aerodynamics and no propulsion, which is the point — it exercises the mass assembly, the rigid-body integrator and the contact model on their own, so that when a wing or a rotor later misbehaves the ground underneath it is known good. Datum is the box centre; feet are 150 mm forward/aft, 100 mm out, 60 mm below.
